HTTP headers Message headers are used to send metadata about a resource or an HTTP message, and to describe the behavior of the client or the server. HTTP request methods Request methods indicate the purpose of the request and what is expected if the request is successful. The most common methods are GET and POST for retrieving and sending data to servers, respectively, but there are other methods which serve different purposes.
